2204.gl: to boil with heat, be hot; used of water; metaphorically; used of boiling anger, love, zeal, for what is good or bad etc.; fervent in spirit, said of zeal for what is good

2205.g: properly, heat, i.e., (figuratively) "zeal" (in a favorable sense, ardor; in an unfavorable one, jealousy, as of a husband (figuratively, of god), or an enemy, malice)
2205.gl: excitement of mind, ardour, fervour of spirit; zeal, ardour in embracing, pursuing, defending anything; zeal in behalf of, for a person or thing; the fierceness of indignation, punitive zeal; an envious and contentious rivalry, jealousy

2206.g: to have warmth of feeling for or against
2206.gl: to burn with zeal; to be heated or to boil with envy, hatred, anger; in a good sense, to be zealous in the pursuit of good; to desire earnestly, pursue; to desire one earnestly, to strive after, busy one's self about him; to exert one's self for one (that he may not be torn from me); to be the object of the zeal of others, to be zealously sought after; to envy

2207.gl: one burning with zeal, a zealot; used of god as jealous of any rival and sternly vindicating his control; most eagerly desirous of, zealous for, a thing; to acquire a thing, (zealous of); to defend and uphold a thing, vehemently contending for a thing

2208.g: a zealot, i.e., (specially) partisan for jewish political independence
2208.gl: one burning with zeal, a zealot; used of god as jealous of any rival and sternly vindicating his control; most eagerly desirous of, zealous for, a thing; to acquire a thing, (zealous of); to defend and uphold a thing, vehemently contending for a thing

2210.g: to injure, i.e., (reflexively or passively) to experience detriment
2210.gl: to affect with damage, do damage to; to sustain damage, to receive injury, suffer loss

2211.gl: [jupiter]; a teacher of the jewish law and afterwards a christian

2212.g: to seek (literally or figuratively); specially, (by hebraism) to worship (god), or (in a bad sense) to plot (against life)
2212.gl: to seek in order to find; to seek a thing; to seek [in order to find out] by thinking, meditating, reasoning, to enquire into; to seek after, seek for, aim at, strive after; to seek i.e., require, demand; to crave, demand something from someone

2213.g: a search (properly concretely), i.e., (in words) a debate
2213.gl: a question, debate; about the law

2214.g: a searching (properly, the act), i.e., a dispute or its theme
2214.gl: a seeking; enquiry; a questioning, debate; a subject of questioning or debate, matter of controversy

2215.gl: a kind of darnel, resembling wheat except the grains are black

2216.gl: [born at babel, i.e., babylon]; the head of the tribe of judah at the time of the return from babylonish captivity in the first year of cyrus

2217.gl: darkness, blackness; used of the darkness of the nether world

2218.g: a coupling, i.e., (figuratively) servitude (a law or obligation); also (literally) the beam of the balance (as connecting the scales)
2218.gl: a yoke; a yoke that is put on draught cattle; metaphorically, used of any burden or bondage; as that of slavery; of troublesome laws imposed on one, especially of the mosaic law, hence the name is so transferred to the commands of christ as to contrast them with the commands of the pharisees which were a veritable 'yoke'; yet even christ's commands must be submitted to, though easier to be kept; a balance, pair of scales

2219.gl: leaven; metaphorically of inveterate mental and moral corruption, viewed in its tendency to infect others leaven is applied to that which, though small in quantity, yet by its influence thoroughly pervades a thing; either in a good sense as in the parable matthew 13:33; or in a bad sense, of a pernicious influence, "a little leaven leaveneth the whole lump"

2220.gl: to leaven; to mix leaven with dough so as to make it ferment

2221.g: to take alive (make a prisoner of war), i.e., (figuratively) to capture or ensnare
2221.gl: to take alive; to take, catch, capture

2222.gl: life; the state of one who is possessed of vitality or is animate; every living soul; life; of the absolute fullness of life, both essential and ethical, which belongs to god, and through him both to the hypostatic "logos" and to christ in whom the "logos" put on human nature; life real and genuine, a life active and vigorous, devoted to god, blessed, in the portion even in this world of those who put their trust in christ, but after the resurrection to be consummated by new accessions (among them a more perfect body), and to last for ever

2223.g: a belt; by implication, a pocket
2223.gl: a girdle, belt, serving not only to gird on flowing garments but also, since it was hollow, to carry money in

2224.g: to bind about (especially with a belt)
2224.gl: to gird; to gird one's self

2225.g: to engender alive, i.e., (by analogy) to rescue (passively, be saved) from death
2225.gl: to bring forth alive; to give life; to preserve alive

2226.g: a live thing, i.e., an animal
2226.gl: a living being; an animal, brute, beast

2227.gl: to produce alive, begat or bear living young; to cause to live, make alive, give life; by spiritual power to arouse and invigorate; to restore to life; to give increase of life: thus of physical life; of the spirit, quickening as respects the spirit, endued with new and greater powers of life; metaphorically, of seeds quickened into life, i.e., germinating, springing up, growing

2230.gl: to be leader, to lead the way; to rule, command; of a province, to be governor of a province; said of a proconsul, of a procurator

2231.gl: chief command, rule, sovereignty; of the reign of a roman emperor

2232.g: a leader, i.e., chief person (or figuratively, place) of a province
2232.gl: a leader of any kind, a guide, ruler, prefect, president, chief, general, commander, sovereign; a "legatus caesaris" (an officer administering a province in the name and with the authority of the roman emperor); the governor of a province; a procurator, an officer who was attached to a proconsul or a proprietor and had charge of the imperial revenues; in causes relating to these revenues he administered justice; of a principal town as the capital of the region

2233.g: to lead, i.e., command (with official authority); figuratively, to deem, i.e., consider
2233.gl: to lead; to go before; to be a leader; to rule, command; to have authority over; a prince, of regal power, governor, viceroy, chief, leading as respects influence, controlling in counsel, overseers or leaders of the churches; used of any kind of leader, chief, commander; the leader in speech, chief, spokesman; to consider, deem, account, think

2238.gl: sweet smelling, garden mint; a kind of small odoriferous herb, with which the jews used to scatter on the floors of their houses and synagogues

2239.gl: a customary abode, dwelling place, haunt, customary state; custom, usage, morals, character

2240.g: to arrive, i.e., be present (literally or figuratively)
2240.gl: to have come, have arrived, be present; metaphorically; to come to one, i.e., to seek an intimacy with one, become his follower: to come upon one (unexpectedly); to come upon one, of things endured

2242.gl: [ascending]; the father of joseph, the husband of mary

2243.gl: [my god is jehovah]; the old testament prophet elijah

2244.gl: age, time of life; age, term or length of life; adult age, maturity; suitable age for anything; metaphorically of an attained state fit for a thing; stature, i.e., in height and comeliness of stature

2245.g: as big as, i.e., (interjectively) how much
2245.gl: as old as, as tall as; how great; how small

2246.gl: the sun; the rays of the sun; the light of day

2250.g: day, i.e., (literally) the time space between dawn and dark, or the whole 24 hours (but several days were usually reckoned by the jews as inclusive of the parts of both extremes); figuratively, a period (always defined more or less clearly by the context)
2250.gl: the day, used of the natural day, or the interval between sunrise and sunset, as distinguished from and contrasted with the night; in the daytime; metaphorically, "the day" is regarded as the time for abstaining from indulgence, vice, crime, because acts of the sort are perpetrated at night and in darkness; of the civil day, or the space of twenty four hours (thus including the night); of the last day of this present age, the day christ will return from heaven, raise the dead, hold the final judgment, and perfect his kingdom; used of time in general, i.e., the days of his life.

2259.gl: at which time, when; whenever, at length when

2260.g: than at all (or than perhaps, than indeed)

2261.g: properly, affable, i.e., mild or kind

2262.gl: [watchful]; the son of jose and the father of elmodam

2264.g: heroic; herod, the name of four jewish kings
2264.gl: [heroic]; the name of a royal family that flourished among the jews in the times of christ and the apostles; herod the great (the ruler of judaea when jesus christ was born; herod surnamed "antipas," the son of herod the great, (the ruler during the latter part of jesus' earthly life; herod agrippa i, the son of aristobulus and berenice and grandson of herod the great, (he ordered james to be executed and imprisoned peter); herod agrippa ii (referred to in the new testament simply as agrippa), son of herod agrippa i (he was almost persuaded to become a christian by paul's arguments)

2265.gl: herodians, i.e., herod's partisans, herod's supporters

2266.g: herodias, a woman of the heodian family
2266.gl: [heroic]; daughter of aristobulus and granddaughter of herod the great

2268.gl: [jehovah's help]; a famous hebrew prophet who prophesied in the reigns of uzziah, jotham, ahaz, and hezekiah

2269.gl: [hairy]; was the eldest son of isaac and twin brother of jacob

2270.g: to keep still (intransitively), i.e., refrain from labor, meddlesomeness or speech
2270.gl: to keep quiet; to rest, cease from labor; to lead a quiet life, said of those who are not running hither and thither, but stay at home and mind their business; to be silent, i.e., to say nothing, hold one's peace

2271.g: (as noun) stillness, i.e., desistance from bustle or language
2271.gl: quietness; description of the life of one who stays at home doing his own work, and does not officiously meddle with the affairs of others; silence

2272.g: properly, keeping one's seat (sedentary), i.e., (by implication) still (undisturbed, undisturbing)

2274.g: to make worse, i.e., vanquish (literally or figuratively); by implication, to rate lower
2274.gl: to make less, inferior, to overcome; to be made inferior; to overcome, worsted, to be conquered by one, forced to yield to one; to hold a thing inferior, set below

2275.g: a deterioration, i.e., (objectively) failure or (subjectively) loss
2275.gl: a diminution, decrease: i.e., defeat; loss, as respects to salvation

2276.g: worse (as noun); by implication, less (as adverb)

2278.g: to make a loud noise, i.e., reverberate
2278.gl: to sound; used of the roaring of the sea

2279.g: a loud or confused noise ("echo"), i.e., roar; figuratively, a rumor
2279.gl: a sound, noise; spoken of the roar of the sea waves; rumour, report

2280.gl: [large hearted, courageous]; one of the twelve apostles, also apparently known as lebbaeus, judas, and jude

2281.gl: the sea; used of the sea in general; used specifically of the mediterranean sea or the red sea

2282.gl: to warm, keep warm; to cherish with tender love, to foster with tender care

2283.gl: [palm tree]; thamar (or tamar), the wife of the two sons of judah, er and onan

2284.gl: to be astonished; to astonish, terrify; to be amazed; to be frightened

2288.g: (properly, an adjective used as a noun) death (literally or figuratively)

2289.gl: to put to death; metaphorically; to make to die i.e., destroy, render extinct; by death to be liberated from the bond of anything, literally to be made dead in relation to (something)

2290.g: to celebrate funeral rites, i.e., inter

2291.g: thara (i.e., terach), the father of abraham

2292.gl: to be of good courage, be of good cheer; to be bold

2293.gl: to be of good courage, be of good cheer

2295.g: wonder (properly concrete; but by implication, abstract)
2295.gl: a wonderful thing, a marvel; wonder; to wonder [with great wonder i.e.,] exceedingly

2296.g: to wonder; by implication, to admire
2296.gl: to wonder, wonder at, marvel; to be wondered at, to be had in admiration

2297.g: wondrous, i.e., (neuter as noun) a miracle

2298.gl: wonderful, marvellous; worthy of pious admiration, admirable, excellent; passing human comprehension; causing amazement joined with terror; marvellous; extraordinary, striking, surprising

2300.g: to look closely at, i.e., (by implication) perceive (literally or figuratively); by extension to visit
2300.gl: to behold, look upon, view attentively, contemplate (often used of public shows); of important persons that are looked on with admiration; to view, take a view of; in the sense of visiting, meeting with a person; to learn by looking, to see with the eyes, to perceive

2301.gl: to bring upon the stage; to set forth as a spectacle, expose to contempt

2302.g: a place for public show ("theatre"), i.e., general audience-room; by implication, a show itself (figuratively)
2302.gl: a theatre, a place in which games and dramatic spectacles are exhibited, and public assemblies held (for the greeks used the theatre also as a forum); a public show; metaphorically, a man who is exhibited to be gazed at and made sport of

2303.gl: brimstone; divine incense, because burning brimstone was regarded as having power to purify, and to ward off disease

2304.gl: a general name of deities or divinities as used by the greeks; spoken of the only and true god, trinity; of christ; holy spirit; the father

2307.g: a determination (properly, the thing), i.e., (actively) choice (specially, purpose, decree; abstractly, volition) or (passively) inclination
2307.gl: what one wishes or has determined shall be done; of the purpose of god to bless mankind through christ; of what god wishes to be done by us; commands, precepts; will, choice, inclination, desire, pleasure

2309.g: to determine (as an active option from subjective impulse; whereas g1014 properly denotes rather a passive acquiescence in objective considerations), i.e., choose or prefer (literally or figuratively); by implication, to wish, i.e., be inclined to (sometimes adverbially, gladly); impersonally for the future tense, to be about to; by hebraism, to delight in
2309.gl: to will, have in mind, intend; to be resolved or determined, to purpose; to desire, to wish; to love; to like to do a thing, be fond of doing; to take delight in, have pleasure

2310.g: something put down, i.e., a substruction (of a building, etc.), (literally or figuratively)
2310.gl: laid down as a foundation, the foundation (of a building, wall, city); metaphorically the foundations, beginnings, first principals; of institution or system of truth

2311.g: to lay a basis for, i.e., (literally) erect, or (figuratively) consolidate
2311.gl: to lay the foundation, to found; to make stable, establish

2315.gl: inspired by god; the contents of the scriptures

2316.g: a deity, especially (with g3588) the supreme divinity; figuratively, a magistrate; exceedingly (by hebraism)
2316.gl: a god or goddess, a general name of deities or divinities; the godhead, trinity; god the father, the first person in the trinity; christ, the second person of the trinity; holy spirit, the third person in the trinity; spoken of the only and true god; refers to the things of god; his counsels, interests, things due to him; whatever can in any respect be likened unto god, or resemble him in any way; god's representative or viceregent; of magistrates and judges

2319.gl: hateful to god, exceptionally impious and wicked

2320.gl: deity; the state of being god, godhead

2321.g: friend of god; theophilus, a christian
2321.gl: [friend of god]; the person to whom luke addressed his gospel and the book of acts

2322.g: attendance (specially, medical, i.e., cure); figuratively and collectively, domestics
2322.gl: service rendered by one to another; specifically medical service: curing, healing; household service; body of attendants, servants, domestics

2323.g: to wait upon menially, i.e., (figuratively) to adore (god), or (specially) to relieve (of disease)
2323.gl: to serve, do service; to heal, cure, restore to health

2324.gl: an attendant, servant: of god; spoken of moses discharging the duties committed to him by god

2325.gl: to reap, harvest; proverbial expression for sowing and reaping; cut off, destroy; as crops are cut down with a sickle

2326.gl: harvest, the act of reaping; figurative for the gathering of men into the kingdom of god; referring to time of reaping, the final judgment, when the righteous are gathered into the kingdom of god and the wicked are cast into hell for ever

2328.gl: to make warm, to heat; to warm one's self

2331.g: a thessalonican, i.e., inhabitant of thessalonice

2332.g: thessalonice, a place in asia minor
2332.gl: [victory of falsity]; a famous and populous city, situated on the thermaic gulf, the capital of the second division of macedonia and the residence of a roman governor and quaestor

2333.gl: [god-given]; the name of an insurgent mentioned in gamaliel's speech before the jewish council at the time of the arraignment of the apostles

2334.g: to be a spectator of, i.e., discern, (literally, figuratively (experience) or intensively (acknowledge))
2334.gl: to be a spectator, look at, behold; to view attentively, take a view of, survey; to view mentally, consider; to see; to perceive with the eyes, to enjoy the presence of one; to discern, descry; to ascertain, find out by seeing

2335.gl: a viewing, beholding; that which is viewed, a spectacle, sight

2336.gl: that which a thing is put or laid away, a receptacle, repository, chest, box; used of the sheath of a sword

2337.gl: to give the breast, give suck, to suckle; to suck

2338.gl: of the female sex; a woman, a female

2339.gl: a hunting of wild beasts to destroy them; metaphorically of preparing destruction for men

2340.g: to hunt (an animal), i.e., (figuratively) to carp at
2340.gl: to go a hunting, to hunt, to catch in hunting; metaphorically to lay wait for, strive to ensnare, catch artfully

2341.g: to be a beast-fighter (in the gladiatorial show), i.e., (figuratively) to encounter (furious men)

2342.gl: an animal; a wild animal, wild beast, beast; metaphorically a brutal, bestial man, savage, ferocious

2343.g: to amass or reserve (literally or figuratively)
2343.gl: to gather and lay up, to heap up, store up; to accumulate riches; to keep in store, store up, reserve; metaphorically so to live from day to day as to increase either the bitterness or the happiness of one's consequent lot

2344.g: a deposit, i.e., wealth (literally or figuratively)
2344.gl: the place in which good and precious things are collected and laid up; a casket, coffer, or other receptacle, in which valuables are kept; a treasury; storehouse, repository, magazine; the things laid up in a treasury, collected treasures

2345.g: to manipulate, i.e., have to do with; by implication, to injure
2345.gl: to touch, handle; to do violence to, injury

2346.gl: to press (as grapes), press hard upon; a compressed way; narrow straitened, contracted; metaphorically to trouble, afflict, distress

2347.gl: a pressing, pressing together, pressure; metaphorically oppression, affliction, tribulation, distress, straits

2348.gl: to die, to be dead; metaphorically to be spiritually dead

2350.g: to be in tumult, i.e., disturb, clamor
2350.gl: to make a noise or uproar, be turbulent; to disturb, throw into confusion; to be troubled in mind; to wail tumultuously

2351.gl: a noise, tumult, uproar; of persons wailing; of a clamorous and excited multitude; of riotous persons; a tumult, as a breach of public order

2352.gl: to break, break in pieces, shatter, smite through

2353.gl: whatever is fed or nursed; a ward, nursling, child; a flock, cattle, especially sheep and goats

2354.gl: to mourn, to lament; of singers of dirges, [to wail]; to bewail, deplore

2356.gl: religious worship; especially external, that which consists of ceremonies; religious discipline, religion

2357.g: ceremonious in worship (as demonstrative), i.e., pious
2357.gl: fearing or worshipping god; to tremble; trembling, fearful

2358.g: and a derivative of g0680 (meaning a noisy iambus, a hymn sung in festal processions in honor of the god bacchus); to make an acclamatory procession, i.e., (figuratively) to conquer or (by hebraism) to give victory
2358.gl: to triumph, to celebrate a triumph; cause one to triumph

2359.gl: the hair of the head; the hair of animals

2360.g: to clamor, i.e., (by implication) to frighten
2360.gl: to cry aloud, make a noise by outcry; in the new testament, to trouble, frighten; to be troubled in mind, to be frightened, alarmed

2361.gl: a large thick drop, especially of clotted blood

2362.g: a stately seat ("throne"); by implication, power or (concretely) a potentate
2362.gl: a throne seat; a chair of state having a footstool; assigned in the new testament to kings, hence, kingly power or royalty; metaphorically to god, the governor of the world; to the messiah, christ, the partner and assistant in the divine administration; hence divine power belonging to christ; to judges i.e., tribunal or bench; to elders

2363.g: thyatira, a place in asia minor
2363.gl: [odor of affliction]; a colony of macedonia greeks, situated between sardis and pergamos on the river lycus; its inhabitants gained their living by traffic and the art of dyeing in purple

2364.g: a female child, or (by hebraism) descendant (or inhabitant)
2364.gl: a daughter; a daughter of god; acceptable to god, rejoicing in god's peculiar care and protection; with the name of a place, city, or region; denotes collectively all its inhabitants and citizens; a female descendant

2367.gl: the citrus, an odoriferous north african tree used as incense, prized by the ancient greeks and romans on account of the beauty of its wood for various ornamental purposes

2368.g: an aroma, i.e., fragrant powder burnt in religious service; by implication, the burning itself

2369.g: a place of fumigation, i.e., the alter of incense (in the temple)
2369.gl: a utensil for fumigating or burning incense; an altar of incense

2370.g: to fumigate, i.e., offer aromatic fumes

2371.g: to be in a furious fight, i.e., (figuratively) to be exasperated
2371.gl: to carry on war with great animosity; to be very angry, be exasperated

2372.gl: passion, angry, heat, anger forthwith boiling up and soon subsiding again; glow, ardour, the wine of passion, inflaming wine (which either drives the drinker mad or kills him with its strength)

2373.g: to put in a passion, i.e., enrage
2373.gl: to cause one to become incensed, to provoke to anger; to be wroth

2374.g: a portal or entrance (the opening or the closure, literally or figuratively)

2375.gl: a shield, a large oblong, four cornered shield

2377.gl: a doorkeeper, porter; a male or female janitor

2378.g: sacrifice (the act or the victim, literally or figuratively)

2379.g: a place of sacrifice, i.e., an altar (special or genitive case, literal or figurative)
2379.gl: the altar for slaying and burning of victims used of; the altar of whole burnt offerings which stood in the court of the priests in the temple at jerusalem; the altar of incense which stood in the sanctuary or the holy place; any other altar; metaphorically, the cross on which christ suffered an expiatory death: to eat of this altar i.e., to appropriate to one's self the fruits of christ's expiatory death

2380.g: properly, to rush (breathe hard, blow, smoke), i.e., (by implication) to sacrifice (properly, by fire, but genitive case); by extension to immolate (slaughter for any purpose)
2380.gl: to sacrifice, immolate; to slay, kill; of the paschal lamb; slaughter

2382.g: the chest ("thorax"), i.e., (by implication) a corslet
2382.gl: the breast, the part of the body from the neck to the navel, where the ribs end; a breastplate or corset consisting of two parts and protecting the body on both sides from the neck to the middle

2383.gl: [whom god enlightens]; a ruler of a synagogue, probably near the western shore of the sea of galilee

2384.g: jacob (i.e., ja`akob), the progenitor of the israelites
2384.gl: [heel-catcher, supplanter]; was the second son of isaac; the father of joseph, the husband of mary

2385.g: jacobus, the name of three israelites
2385.gl: [supplanter]; son of zebedee, an apostle and brother of the apostle john, commonly called james the greater or elder, slain by herod, acts 12; an apostle, son of alphaeus, called the less; james the half-brother of christ; an unknown james, father of the apostle judas(?)

2386.gl: a means of healing, remedy, medicine; a healing

2387.gl: [foamy healer]; jambres, one of pharaoh's magicians who attempted to replicate moses' miracles in the old testament

2388.gl: [flourishing]; son of joseph and the father of melchi, in the genealogy of christ

2389.gl: [he vexed]; jannes, one of pharaoh's magicians who attempted to replicate moses' miracles in the old testament

2390.gl: to cure, heal; to make whole; to free from errors and sins, to bring about (one's) salvation

2391.gl: [descent]; one of the antediluvian patriarchs, the father of enoch

2393.gl: jasper, a precious stone of various colors (for some are purple, others blue, others green, and others the color of brass)

2394.g: about to cure; jason, a christian
2394.gl: [one who will heal]; a thessalonians who entertained paul and silas, and maybe a cousin of paul (romans 16:21)

2396.g: used as an interjection to denote surprise; lo!

2398.g: pertaining to self, i.e., one's own; by implication, private or separate
2398.gl: pertaining to one's self, one's own, belonging to one's self

2399.g: a private person, i.e., (by implication) an ignoramus (compare "idiot")
2399.gl: a private person as opposed to a magistrate, ruler, king; a common soldier, as opposed to a military officer; a writer of prose as opposed to a poet; in the new testament, an unlearned, illiterate, man as opposed to the learned and educated: one who is unskilled in any art

2401.g: idumaea (i.e., edom), a region east (and south) of palestine
2401.gl: idumaea, the name of a region between southern palestine and the arabian petraea inhabited by edom or esau and his posterity

2403.g: jezabel (i.e., jezebel), a tyrian woman (used as a synonym of a termagant or false teacher)

4690.g: something sown, i.e., seed (including the male "sperm"); by implication, offspring; specially, a remnant (figuratively, as if kept over for planting)
4690.gl: from which a plant germinates; the seed i.e., the grain or kernel which contains within itself the germ of the future plants; of the grains or kernels sown; metaphorically a seed i.e., a residue, or a few survivors reserved as the germ of a new race (just as seed is kept from the harvest for the sowing); the semen virile; the product of this semen, seed, children, offspring, progeny; family, race, posterity; whatever possesses vital force or life giving power; of divine energy of the holy spirit operating within the soul by which we are regenerated

4691.g: a seed-picker (as the crow), i.e., (figuratively) a sponger, loafer (specially, a gossip or trifler in talk)
4691.gl: picking up seed; of birds, especially of the crow or daw that picks up grain in fields; metaphorically; lounging about the market place and picking up a substance by whatever may chance to fall from the loads of merchandise; hence, beggarly, abject, vile, (a parasite); getting a living by flattery and bufferoonery; an empty talker, babbler

4692.g: to "speed" ("study"), i.e., urge on (diligently or earnestly); by implication, to await eagerly
4692.gl: to haste, make haste; to desire earnestly

4693.g: a cavern; by implication, a hiding-place or resort

4694.g: a ledge or reef of rock in the sea
4694.gl: a rock in the sea, ledge, reef; metaphorically of men who by their conduct damage others morally, wreck them as it were

4695.g: to stain or soil (literally or figuratively)

4696.g: a stain or blemish, i.e., (figuratively) defect, disgrace
4696.gl: a spot; a fault, moral blemish; of base and gluttonous men

4697.g: to have the bowels yearn, i.e., (figuratively) feel sympathy, to pity
4697.gl: to be moved as to one's bowels, hence to be moved with compassion, have compassion (for the bowels were thought to be the seat of love and pity)

4698.g: an intestine (plural); figuratively, pity or sympathy
4698.gl: bowels, intestines, (the heart, lungs, liver, etc.); bowels; the bowels were regarded as the seat of the more violent passions, such as anger and love; but by the hebrews as the seat of the tenderer affections, especially kindness, benevolence, compassion; hence our heart (tender mercies, affections, etc.); a heart in which mercy resides

4700.gl: ashes: placed on sackcloth as a token of grief

4702.g: sown, i.e., (neuter plural) a planted field
4702.gl: fit for sowing, sown; sown fields, growing crops

4703.g: a scattering (of seed), i.e., (concretely) seed (as sown)

4704.g: to use speed, i.e., to make effort, be prompt or earnest
4704.gl: to hasten, make haste; to exert one's self, endeavor, give diligence

4705.gl: active, diligent, zealous, earnest; very diligent

4706.g: more earnestly than others), i.e., very promptly

4707.gl: active, diligent, zealous, earnest; very diligent

4708.g: more speedily, i.e., sooner than otherwise

4710.gl: haste, with haste; earnestness, diligence; earnestness in accomplishing, promoting, or striving after anything; to give all diligence, interest one's self most earnestly

4711.gl: a reed basket, (a plaited basket, a lunch basket, hamper)

4712.g: a stade or certain measure of distance; by implication, a stadium or race-course
4712.gl: a space or distance of about 600 feet (185 m); a race course; place in which contests in running were held, the one who outstripped the rest and reached the goal first, receiving the prize

4713.gl: among the greeks an earthen jar, into which wine was drawn off for keeping but also used for other purposes; of the little jar in which the manna was kept, laid up in the ark of the covenant

4714.g: a standing (properly, the act), i.e., (by analogy) position (existence); by implication, a popular uprising; figuratively, controversy
4714.gl: a standing, station, state; an insurrection; strife, insurrection

4715.g: a stander (standard of value), i.e., (specially), a stater or certain coin
4715.gl: a stater, a coin; in the new testament a silver stater equal to four attic or two alexandrian drachmas, a jewish shekel

4716.g: a stake or post (as set upright), i.e., (specially), a pole or cross (as an instrument of capital punishment); figuratively, exposure to death, i.e., self-denial; by implication, the atonement of christ
4716.gl: an upright stake, especially a pointed one; a cross; a well known instrument of most cruel and ignominious punishment, borrowed by the greeks and romans from the phoenicians; to it were affixed among the romans, down to the time of constantine the great, the guiltiest criminals, particularly the basest slaves, robbers, the authors and abetters of insurrections, and occasionally in the provinces, at the arbitrary pleasure of the governors, upright and peaceable men also, and even roman citizens themselves; the crucifixion which christ underwent

4717.g: to impale on the cross; figuratively, to extinguish (subdue) passion or selfishness
4717.gl: to stake, drive down stakes; to fortify with driven stakes, to palisade; to crucify; to crucify one; metaphorically to crucify the flesh, destroy its power utterly (the nature of the figure implying that the destruction is attended with intense pain)

4718.g: a cluster of grapes (as if intertwined)

4719.g: a head of grain (as standing out from the stalk)
4719.gl: an ear of corn or of growing grain

4720.gl: [a head of grain]; a man with a greek name, he is said to be one of the seventy disciples, and bishop of byzantium (gill)

4722.g: to roof over, i.e., (figuratively) to cover with silence (endure patiently)
4722.gl: deck, thatch, to cover; to protect or keep by covering, to preserve; to cover over with silence; to keep secret; to hide, conceal; of the errors and faults of others; by covering to keep off something which threatens, to bear up against, hold out against, and so endure, bear, forbear

4723.gl: hard, stiff; of men and animals; barren; of woman who does not conceive

4724.g: properly, to set fast ("stall"), i.e., (figuratively) to repress (reflexively, abstain from associating with)
4724.gl: to set, place, set in order, arrange; to fit out, to prepare, equip; to prepare one's self, to fit out for one's self; to fit out for one's own use; to prepare one's self, to fit out for one's self; to fit out for one's own use; arranging, providing for this, etc.; to bring together, contract, shorten; to diminish, check, cause to cease; to cease to exist; to remove one's self, withdraw one's self, to depart; to abstain from familiar intercourse with one

4725.gl: a fillet, a garland, put upon victims

4727.g: to make (intransitively, be) in straits, i.e., (by implication) to sigh, murmur, pray inaudibly

4729.g: to hem in closely, i.e., (figuratively) cramp
4729.gl: to be in a narrow place; to straiten, compress, cramp, reduce to straits; to be sorely straitened in spirit

4730.gl: narrowness of place, a narrow place; metaphorically dire calamity, extreme affliction

4731.g: stiff, i.e., solid, stable (literally or figuratively)
4731.gl: strong, firm, immovable, solid, hard, rigid; in a bad sense, cruel, stiff, stubborn, hard; in a good sense, firm, steadfast

4732.g: to solidify, i.e., confirm (literally or figuratively)
4732.gl: to make solid, make firm, strengthen, make strong; of the body of anyone

4733.gl: that which has been made firm; the firmament, the arch of the sky, which in early times was thought to be solid; a fortified place; that which furnishes a foundation; on which a thing rests firmly, support; firmness, steadfastness; metaphorically in a military sense: solid front

4735.g: a chaplet (as a badge of royalty, a prize in the public games or a symbol of honor generally; but more conspicuous and elaborate than the simple fillet, g1238), literally or figuratively
4735.gl: a crown; a mark of royal or (generally) exalted rank; the wreath or garland which was given as a prize to victors in public games; metaphorically the eternal blessedness which will be given as a prize to the genuine servants of god and christ: the crown (wreath) which is the reward of the righteous; that which is an ornament and honor to one

4736.gl: [crowned]; one of the seven deacons in jerusalem and the first christian martyr

4737.g: to adorn with an honorary wreath (literally or figuratively)
4737.gl: to encircle with a crown, to crown: the victor in a contest; to adorn, to honor

4739.g: to be stationary, i.e., (figuratively) to persevere
4739.gl: to stand firm; to persevere, to persist; to keep one's standing

4741.g: to set fast, i.e., (literally) to turn resolutely in a certain direction, or (figuratively) to confirm
4741.gl: to make stable, place firmly, set fast, fix; to strengthen, make firm; to render constant, confirm, one's mind

4742.g: a mark incised or punched (for recognition of ownership), i.e., (figuratively) scar of service
4742.gl: a mark pricked in or branded upon the body

4743.g: a point of time, i.e., an instant
4743.gl: an instant (i.e., a moment) of time

4745.gl: a portico, a covered colonnade where people can stand or walk protected from the weather and the heat of the sun; the portico built by solomon in the eastern part of the temple

4746.g: a spread (as if tramped flat) of loose materials for a couch, i.e., (by implication) a bough of a tree so employed

4747.g: something orderly in arrangement, i.e., (by implication) a serial (basal, fundamental, initial) constituent (literally), proposition (figuratively)
4747.gl: any first thing, from which the others belonging to some series or composite whole take their rise, an element, first principal; the letters of the alphabet as the elements of speech, not however the written characters, but the spoken sounds; the elements from which all things have come, the material causes of the universe; the heavenly bodies, either as parts of the heavens or (as others think) because in them the elements of man, life and destiny were supposed to reside; the elements, rudiments, primary and fundamental principles of any art, science, or discipline; i.e., of mathematics, euclid's geometry

4748.g: to march in (military) rank (keep step), i.e., (figuratively) to conform to virtue and piety
4748.gl: to proceed in a row as the march of a soldier, go in order; metaphorically to go on prosperously, to turn out well; to walk; to direct one's life, to live

4749.g: equipment, i.e., (specially), a "stole" or long-fitting gown (as a mark of dignity)
4749.gl: an equipment; an equipment in clothes, clothing; specifically a loose outer garment for men extending to the feet, worn by kings, priests, and persons of rank

4750.g: the mouth (as if a gash in the face); by implication, language (and its relations); figuratively, an opening (in the earth); specially, the front or edge (of a weapon)
4750.gl: the mouth, as part of the body: of man, of animals, of fish, etc.; since thoughts of a man's soul find verbal utterance by his mouth, the "heart" or "soul" and the mouth are distinguished; the edge of a sword

4751.gl: the throat; an opening, orifice, especially of the stomach; the stomach

4752.g: military service, i.e., (figuratively) the apostolic career (as one of hardship and danger)
4752.gl: an expedition, campaign, military service, warfare; metaphorically paul likens his contest with the difficulties that oppose him in the discharge of his apostolic duties, as warfare

4753.g: an armament, i.e., (by implication) a body of troops (more or less extensive or systematic)
4753.gl: an army; a band of soldiers; bodyguard, guards men

4754.g: to serve in a military campaign; figuratively, to execute the apostolate (with its arduous duties and functions), to contend with carnal inclinations
4754.gl: to make a military expedition, to lead soldiers to war or to battle, (spoken of a commander); to do military duty, be on active service, be a soldier; to fight

4755.g: a general, i.e., (by implication or analogy) a (military) governor (praetor), the chief (praefect) of the (levitical) temple-wardens
4755.gl: the commander of an army; in the new testament a civic commander, a governor; the name the highest magistrate in the municipia or colonies; they had the power of administering justice in the less important cases; of civil magistrates; captain of the temple, i.e., the commander of the levites who kept guard in and around the temple

4756.g: from the base of g4766, as encamped); camp-likeness, i.e., an army, i.e., (figuratively) the angels, the celestial luminaries
4756.gl: an army, band of soldiers; in the new testament, the hosts of heaven; troops of angels; the heavenly bodies, stars of heaven (so called on account of their number and their order)

4757.g: a camper-out, i.e., a (common) warrior (literally or figuratively)
4757.gl: a (common) soldier; metaphorically a champion of the cause of christ

4758.g: to gather (or select) as a warrior, i.e., enlist in the army
4758.gl: to gather (collect) an army, to enlist soldiers; of the commander

4759.g: a ruler of an army, i.e., (specially), a praetorian praefect
4759.gl: the commander of a camp and army, a military tribune; praetorian praefect (or prefect), commander of the praetorian cohorts, captain of the roman emperor's body guard

4760.g: a camping-ground, i.e., (by implication) a body of troops
4760.gl: a military camp; soldiers in camp, an army

4761.g: to wrench, i.e., (specially), to torture (by the rack), but only figuratively, to pervert
4761.gl: to twist, turn awry; to torture, put to the rack; metaphorically to pervert, of one who wrests or tortures language in a false sense

4762.g: to twist, i.e., turn quite around or reverse (literally or figuratively)
4762.gl: to turn, turn around; to turn one's self (i.e., to turn the back to one; of one who no longer cares for another); metaphorically to turn one's self from one's course of conduct, i.e., to change one's mind

4763.gl: to be wanton, to live luxuriously

4764.gl: excessive strength which longs to break forth, over strength; luxury; eager desire

4765.gl: a little bird, especially of the sparrow sort, a sparrow

4766.g: to "strew," i.e., spread (as a carpet or couch)
4766.gl: to spread; furnish; to spread with couches or divans

4768.g: to render gloomy, i.e., (by implication) glower (be overcast with clouds, or sombreness of speech)
4768.gl: to be sad, sorrowful; metaphorically of the sky covered with clouds

4769.gl: a pillar; a column; pillars of fire i.e., flames rising like pillars; a prop or support

4770.g: a "stoic" (as occupying a particular porch in athens), i.e., adherent of a certin philosophy
4770.gl: [of the portico]; pertaining to the stoic philosophy, the author of which, zeno of citium, taught at athens

4772.gl: a kinship, relationship; kindred, relations collectively, family

4773.g: a relative (by blood); by extension, a fellow countryman
4773.gl: of the same kin, akin to, related by blood; in a wider sense, of the same race, a fellow countryman

4775.g: to seat oneself in company with
4775.gl: to sit together, to sit with one another

4776.g: to give (or take) a seat in company with
4776.gl: to cause to sit down together, place together; to sit down together

4777.g: to suffer hardship in company with
4777.gl: to suffer hardship together with one

4778.g: to maltreat in company with, i.e., (passively) endure persecution together
4778.gl: to treat ill with another; to be ill treated in company with, share persecutions or come into a fellowship of ills

4779.gl: to call together, assemble; to call together to one's self

4780.gl: to cover on all sides, to conceal entirely, to cover up completely

4781.g: to bend together, i.e., (figuratively) to afflict
4781.gl: to bend together, to bend completely; metaphorically to subject one to error and hardness of heart, a figure taken from bowing the back by captives compelled to pass under the yoke

4782.gl: to go down with; of those who descend from a high place to a lower place as from jerusalem to caesarea

4783.g: a deposition (of sentiment) in company with, i.e., (figuratively) accord with
4783.gl: a putting together or joint deposit (of votes); hence approval, assent, agreement

4784.g: to deposit (one's vote or opinion) in company with, i.e., (figuratively) to accord with
4784.gl: to deposit together with another; to deposit one's vote in the urn with another; to consent to, vote for, agree with

4785.g: to count down in company with, i.e., enroll among
4785.gl: be depositing a ballot in the urn (i.e., by voting for) to assign one a place among, to vote one a place among; to vote against with others, i.e., to condemn with others

4786.g: to commingle, i.e., (figuratively) to combine or assimilate
4786.gl: to mix together, commingle; to unite; caused the several parts to combine into an organic structure, which is the body; to unite one thing to another

4787.g: to move together, i.e., (specially), to excite as a mass (to sedition)
4787.gl: to move together with others; to throw into commotion, excite, stir up

4788.g: to shut together, i.e., include or (figuratively) embrace in a common subjection to
4788.gl: to shut up together, enclose; of a shoal of fishes in a net; to shut up on all sides, shut up completely

4789.g: a co-heir, i.e., (by analogy) participant in common
4789.gl: a fellow heir, a joint heir; one who obtains something assigned to himself with others, a joint participant

4790.g: to share in company with, i.e., co-participate in
4790.gl: to become a partaker together with others, or to have fellowship with a thing

4791.gl: participant with others in anything, joint partner

4792.g: to convey together, i.e., collect or bear away in company with others
4792.gl: to carry or bring together, to collect; to house crops, gather into granaries; to carry with others, help in carrying out, the dead to be buried or burned; to bury

4793.g: to judge of one thing in connection with another, i.e., combine (spiritual ideas with appropriate expressions) or collate (one person with another by way of contrast or resemblance)
4793.gl: to joint together fitly, compound, combine; to interpret; to compare

4794.g: to stoop altogether, i.e., be completely overcome by
4794.gl: to bend completely forwards, to be bowed together

4796.gl: to rejoice with, take part in another's joy; to rejoice together, to congratulate

4797.g: to commingle promiscuously, i.e., (figuratively) to throw (an assembly) into disorder, to perplex (the mind)
4797.gl: to pour together, commingle; to disturb the mind of one, to stir up to tumult or outbreak; to confound or bewilder

4798.g: to use jointly, i.e., (by implication) to hold intercourse in common
4798.gl: to use with anyone, use jointly; to associate with, to have dealings with

4800.g: to continue to live in common with, i.e., co-survive (literally or figuratively)
4800.gl: to live together with one; of physical life on earth; to live a new life in union with christ, i.e., dedicated to god

4801.g: to yoke together, i.e., (figuratively) conjoin (in marriage)
4801.gl: to fasten to one yoke, yoke together; to join together unite; of the marriage tie

4802.g: to investigate jointly, i.e., discuss, controvert, cavil
4802.gl: to seek or examine together; in the new testament to discuss, dispute, question

4804.gl: a disputer, i.e., a learned disputant, sophist

4805.g: co-yoked, i.e., (figuratively) as noun, a colleague; probably rather as a proper name; syzygus, a christian
4805.gl: yoked together; of those united by the bond of marriage, relationship, office, labor, study, business, or the like; of a yoke fellow, consort, comrade, colleague, partner

4806.gl: to make one alive together; of christians, with christ

4807.gl: sycamine tree, having the form and foliage of the mulberry, but fruit resembling the fig

4810.gl: a fig, the ripe fruit of a fig tree

4811.g: to be a fig-informer (reporter of the law forbidding the exportation of figs from greece), "sycophant", i.e., (genitive and by extension) to defraud (exact unlawfully, extort)
4811.gl: to accuse wrongfully, to calumniate, to attack by malicious devices; to exact money wrongfully; to extort from, defraud

4812.g: to lead away as booty, i.e., (figuratively) seduce
4812.gl: to carry off booty; to carry one off as a captive (and slave); to lead away from the truth and subject to one's sway

4815.g: to clasp, i.e., seize (arrest, capture); specially, to conceive (literally or figuratively); by implication, to aid
4815.gl: to seize, take: one as prisoner; to conceive, of a woman; metaphorically of lust whose impulses a man indulges; to seize for one's self; in a hostile sense, to make (one a permanent) prisoner; to take hold together with one, to assist, help, to succour

4816.gl: to gather up; to collect in order to carry off

4817.g: to reckon together (with oneself), i.e., deliberate
4817.gl: to bring together accounts, reckon up, compute; to reckon with one's self, to reason

4818.g: to afflict jointly, i.e., (passive) sorrow at (on account of) someone
4818.gl: to affect with grief together; give with one's self

4819.g: to walk (figuratively, transpire) together, i.e., concur (take place)
4819.gl: to walk with the feet near together; to come together, meet with one; of things which fall out at the same time, to happen, turn out, come to pass

4820.g: to combine, i.e., (in speaking) to converse, consult, dispute, (mentally) to consider, (by implication) to aid, (personally) to join, attack
4820.gl: to throw together, to bring together; to converse; to bring together in one's mind, confer with one's self; to come together, meet; to encounter in a hostile sense; to fight with one; to bring together of one's property, to contribute, aid, help

4821.gl: to reign together; metaphorically to possess supreme honor, liberty, blessedness, with one in the kingdom of god

4822.g: causative (by reduplication) of the base of g0939); to drive together, i.e., unite (in association or affection), (mentally) to infer, show, teach
4822.gl: to cause to coalesce, to join together, put together; to unite or knit together: in affection; to put together in one's mind; to compare; to gather, conclude, consider; to cause a person to unite with one in a conclusion or come to the same opinion, to prove, demonstrate; to teach, instruct, one

4823.g: to give (or take) advice jointly, i.e., recommend, deliberate or determine
4823.gl: to give counsel; to take counsel with others, take counsel together, to consult, deliberate

4824.g: advisement; specially, a deliberative body, i.e., the provincial assessors or lay-court
4824.gl: counsel, which is given, taken, entered upon; consult, deliberate; a council; an assembly of counsellors or persons in consultation (the governors and procurators of provinces had a board of assessors or advisers with whom they took council before rendering judgment)

4826.g: symeon (i.e., shimon), the name of five israelites
4826.gl: [harkening]; the second son of jacob by leah; one of abraham's descendants; the one who took the infant jesus in his arms in the temple; a teacher at the church of antioch; the original name of peter the apostle

4828.g: to testify jointly, i.e., corroborate by (concurrent) evidence
4828.gl: to bear witness with, bear joint witness

4829.g: to share jointly, i.e., participate in
4829.gl: to divide at the same time, divide together; to assign a portion; to divide together with one (so that a part comes to me, a part to him)

4830.gl: partaking together with one, a joint partaker; of something

4832.gl: having the same form as another, similar, conformed to

4833.g: to render like, i.e., (figuratively) to assimilate
4833.gl: to be conformed to, receive the same form as

4834.g: to feel "sympathy" with, i.e., (by implication) to commiserate
4834.gl: to be affected with the same feeling as another, to sympathise with; to feel for, have compassion on

4835.g: having a fellow-feeling ("sympathetic"), i.e., (by implication) mutually commiserative
4835.gl: suffering or feeling the like with another, sympathetic

4836.g: to be present together, i.e., to convene; by implication, to appear in aid
4836.gl: to come together; to come to one's help

4837.gl: to call upon or invite or exhort at the same time or together; to strengthen (comfort) with others

4838.gl: to take along together with; in the new testament to take with one as a companion

4839.g: to remain in company, i.e., still live
4839.gl: to abide together with; to continue to live together

4840.g: to be at hand together, i.e., now present

4841.g: to experience pain jointly or of the same kind (specially, persecution; to "sympathize")
4841.gl: to suffer or feel pain together; to suffer evils (troubles, persecutions) in the like manner with another

4843.g: to take by enclosing altogether, i.e., earnestly throw the arms about one
4843.gl: to comprehend at once; to embrace completely

4844.g: to partake a beverage in company

4845.g: to implenish completely, i.e., (of space) to swamp (a boat), or (of time) to accomplish (passive, be complete)
4845.gl: to fill completely; of the hold of a ship; to complete entirely, be fulfilled: of time

4846.g: to strangle completely, i.e., (literally) to drown, or (figuratively) to crowd
4846.gl: to choke utterly; metaphorically the seed of the divine word sown in the mind; to press round or throng one so as almost to suffocate him

4847.g: a native of the same town, i.e., (figuratively) co-religionist (fellow-christian)
4847.gl: possessing the same citizenship with others, a fellow citizen; of gentiles as received into communion of the saints; of the people consecrated to god

4848.g: to journey together; by implication, to assemble
4848.gl: to go or journey together; to come together, to assemble

4849.g: a drinking-party ("symposium"), i.e., (by extension) a room of guests
4849.gl: a drinking party, entertainment; of the party itself, the guests; rows of guests

4851.g: to bear together (contribute), i.e., (literally) to collect, or (figuratively) to conduce; especially (neuter participle as a noun) advantage
4851.gl: to bear or bring together; to bear together or at the same time; to carry with others; to collect or contribute in order to help; to help, be profitable, be expedient

4852.g: to say jointly, i.e., assent to

4853.g: a co-tribesman, i.e., native of the same country
4853.gl: one who is of the same people, a fellow countryman

4854.g: grown along with (connate), i.e., (figuratively) closely united to
4854.gl: born together with, of joint origin; connate, congenital, innate, implanted by birth or nature; grown together, united with; kindred

4855.gl: to cause to grow together; to grow together, grow with

4856.g: to be harmonious, i.e., (figuratively) to accord (be suitable, concur) or stipulate (by compact)
4856.gl: to agree together; to agree with one in making a bargain, to make an agreement, to bargain

4858.g: unison of sound ("symphony"), i.e., a concert of instruments (harmonious note)

4859.g: sounding together (alike), i.e., (figuratively) accordant (neuter as noun, agreement)
4859.gl: harmonious, accordant, agreeing; thing agreed upon, compact

4860.gl: to compute, count up; to vote with one

4861.gl: of one mind, of one accord

5570.g: a spurious apostle, i.e., pretended pracher
5570.gl: a false apostle, one who falsely claims to be an ambassador of christ

5572.g: a spurious teacher, i.e., propagator of erroneous christian doctrine

5573.g: mendacious, i.e., promulgating erroneous christian doctrine

5574.g: to utter an untruth or attempt to deceive by falsehood
5574.gl: to lie, to speak deliberate falsehoods; to deceive one by a lie, to lie to

5575.g: a spurious witness, i.e., bearer of untrue testimony

5576.g: to be an untrue testifier, i.e., offer falsehood in evidence
5576.gl: to utter falsehoods in giving testimony, to testify falsely, to bear false witness

5578.g: a spurious prophet, i.e., pretended foreteller or religious impostor
5578.gl: one who, acting the part of a divinely inspired prophet, utters falsehoods under the name of divine prophecies; a false prophet

5579.gl: a lie; conscious and intentional falsehood; in a broad sense, whatever is not what it seems to be; of perverse, impious, deceitful precepts

5580.gl: a false christ (or messiah); one who falsely lays claim to the name and office of the messiah

5582.gl: a falsehood, a lie; the perfidy by which a man by sinning breaks faith with god

5583.gl: a liar; one who breaks faith; a false and faithless man

5584.g: to manipulate, i.e., verify by contact; figuratively, to search for
5584.gl: to handle, touch and feel; metaphorically mentally to seek after tokens of a person or a thing

5585.g: to use pebbles in enumeration, i.e., (generally) to compute
5585.gl: to count with pebbles, to compute, calculate, reckon; to give one's vote by casting a pebble into the urn; to decide by voting

5586.g: a pebble (as worn smooth by handling), i.e., (by implication, of use as a counter or ballot) a verdict (of acquittal) or ticket (of admission); a vote
5586.gl: a small worn smooth stone, a pebble; in the ancient courts of justice the accused were condemned by black pebbles and the acquitted by white; a vote (on account of the use of pebbles in voting)

5587.gl: a whispering, i.e., secret slandering; of the magical murmuring of a charmer of snakes

5590.g: breath, i.e., (by implication) spirit, abstractly or concretely (the animal sentient principle only; thus distinguished on the one hand from g4151, which is the rational and immortal soul; and on the other from g2222, which is mere vitality, even of plants: these terms thus exactly correspond respectively to the hebrew h5315, h7307 and h2416)
5590.gl: breath; the breath of life; the vital force which animates the body and shows itself in breathing; of animals; of men; life; that in which there is life; a living being, a living soul; the soul; the seat of the feelings, desires, affections, aversions (our heart, soul etc.); the (human) soul in so far as it is constituted that by the right use of the aids offered it by god it can attain its highest end and secure eternal blessedness, the soul regarded as a moral being designed for everlasting life; the soul as an essence which differs from the body and is not dissolved by death (distinguished from other parts of the body)

5591.g: sensitive, i.e., animate (in distinction on the one hand from g4152, which is the higher or renovated nature; and on the other from g5446, which is the lower or bestial nature)
5591.gl: of or belonging to breath; having the nature and characteristics of the breath; the principal of animal life, which men have in common with the brutes; governed by breath; the sensuous nature with its subjection to appetite and passion

5593.gl: cold, cool; of cool water; metaphorically; cold i.e., sluggish, inert; in mind: of one destitute of warm christian faith and the desire for holiness

5594.g: to breathe (voluntarily but gently, thus differing on the one hand from g4154, which denotes properly a forcible respiration; and on the other from the base of g0109, which refers properly to an inanimate breeze), i.e., (by implication, of reduction of temperature by evaporation) to chill (figuratively)
5594.gl: to breathe, blow, cool by blowing; to be made or grow cool or cold; metaphorically of waning love

5595.g: to supply with bits, i.e., (generally) to nourish
5595.gl: to feed by putting a bit or crumb (of food) into the mouth; of infants, young animals etc.; to feed, nourish; to give a thing to feed someone, feed out to

5596.g: a crumb or morsel (as if rubbed off), i.e., a mouthful

5597.g: to triturate, i.e., (by analogy) to rub out (kernels from husks with the fingers or hand)
5597.gl: to rub, to rub to pieces

5598.g: the last letter of the greek alphabet, i.e., (figuratively) the finality
5598.gl: the last letter in the greek alphabet; the last

5599.g: as a sign of the vocative case, o; as a note of exclamation, oh

5600.g: (may, might, can, could, would, should, must, etc.; also with g1487 and its comparative, as well as with other particles) be

5602.g: in this same spot, i.e., here or hither

5603.g: a chant or "ode" (the general term for any words sung; while g5215 denotes especially a religious metrical composition, and g5568 still more specially, a hebrew cantillation)

5604.g: a pang or throe, especially of childbirth
5604.gl: the pain of childbirth, travail pain, birth pangs; intolerable anguish, in reference to the dire calamities precede the advent of the messiah

5605.g: to experience the pains of parturition (literally or figuratively)
5605.gl: to feel the pains of child birth, to travail

5606.g: the shoulder (as that on which burdens are borne)

5608.g: to purchase (synonymous with the earlier g4092)

5610.gl: a certain definite time or season fixed by natural law and returning with the revolving year; of the seasons of the year, spring, summer, autumn, winter; the daytime (bounded by the rising and setting of the sun), a day; a twelfth part of the day-time, an hour, (the twelve hours of the day are reckoned from the rising to the setting of the sun); any definite time, point of time, moment

5611.g: belonging to the right hour or season (timely), i.e., (by implication) flourishing (beauteous (figuratively))
5611.gl: blooming, beautiful (used of the human body)

5612.gl: to roar, to howl (of a lion, wolf, dog, and other beasts); of men, to raise a loud and inarticulate cry: either of grief, or of joy; to sing with a loud voice

5613.g: which how, i.e., in that manner (very variously used, as follows)

5614.g: oh save!; hosanna (i.e., hoshia-na), an exclamation of adoration

5615.g: as thus, i.e., in the same way

5616.gl: as it were, (had been), as though, as, like as, like; about, nearly; before numerals; before a measure of time

5617.gl: [salvation]; the well known hebrew prophet, son of beeri and contemporary with isaiah

5619.g: just as if, i.e., as it were

5620.g: so too, i.e., thus therefore (in various relations of consecution, as follow)
5620.gl: so that, insomuch that; so then, therefore, wherefore

5621.g: an earlet, i.e., one of the ears, or perhaps the lobe of the ear

5623.g: to be useful, i.e., to benefit
5623.gl: to assist, to be useful or advantageous, to profit
